summary: A floor-based hip-extension technique with bent knees and two supported feet.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to the source-described hip extension; exercise involvement is not measured or ranked.

setup: Lie on your back, knees bent and feet flat hip-width apart. Keep a gentle abdominal contraction.
executionSteps: Exhale, press through the heels and lift the hips while contracting the glutes; avoid excessive lower-back arching.
Inhale while lowering slowly to the starting position.
technique.finishOrReset: Return under control to the described starting position.
keyCheckpoints: Maintain abdominal contraction and limit the lift.
technique.breathing: Exhale while lifting; inhale while lowering.

mistakes.mistake: Lifting beyond controlled hip extension into excessive lower-back arching.
mistakes.correction: Maintain abdominal contraction and limit the lift.

summary: The ACE single-leg bridge version holds the opposite thigh near the chest while the supported hip extends.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to the source-described hip extension; exercise involvement is not measured or ranked.

setup: Lie on your back with bent knees. Hold behind one thigh and draw that knee toward the chest; move the supported foot toward the midline.
Keep gentle abdominal stiffness and a supported heel.
executionSteps: Exhale, press the supported heel down and contract the glute to raise the hips without excessive back arching.
Inhale while lowering slowly. Repeat on the other side; no repetition count or duration is specified.
technique.finishOrReset: Return under control to the described starting position.
keyCheckpoints: Maintain abdominal stiffness and reduce the lift.
technique.breathing: Exhale while lifting; inhale while lowering.

mistakes.mistake: Pushing the hip lift into excessive lower-back extension.
mistakes.correction: Maintain abdominal stiffness and reduce the lift.

summary: A hands-and-knees opposite-arm/leg movement with controlled spinal and pelvic position.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to the source-described hip extension; exercise involvement is not measured or ranked.

setup: Place hands below shoulders and knees below hips, toes dorsiflexed and fingers forward. Brace gently with a neutral spine.
executionSteps: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg backward toward floor-parallel only as far as back and pelvis control allow.
Keep hips and shoulders level and the head aligned. Lower gently and repeat with the opposite limbs.
technique.finishOrReset: Return under control to the described starting position.

mistakes.mistake: Raising a limb beyond the ability to keep the back and pelvis controlled.

summary: A seated selectorized cable-machine pull with supported thighs and controlled shoulder and elbow movement.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to lowering the raised arm; this guide does not measure or rank muscle activation.

setup: Adjust thigh support and sit with feet supported. Brace without excessive back arching; align the head and set shoulders down/back.
Use the guide's slight backward lean, no more than 30 degrees, and keep that torso position throughout the pull.
executionSteps: Exhale, depress the shoulder blades and draw the bar toward the upper/middle chest with elbows moving down beside the torso.
Stop near the chest or when elbows stop descending and begin moving backward. Pause, then control the return as elbows extend.
technique.finishOrReset: Return under control to the described starting position.
keyCheckpoints: Keep the initial torso position and stop at the described endpoint.
technique.breathing: Exhale while pulling down; the guide does not assign a separate inhalation phase.

mistakes.mistake: Leaning farther backward or continuing the pull after elbows stop moving downward.
mistakes.correction: Keep the initial torso position and stop at the described endpoint.
